title: AI Agent & Workflow Specialist for MapleSpark

facts: Original jd.txt: MapleSpark is an education technology company using both Claude Code and Codex.
Original jd.txt: Run agents; check active tasks at least hourly during working hours; catch stalls, missed instructions and incorrect results; inspect outputs personally.
Original jd.txt: Break tasks into steps, add checks, test approaches, document processes and communicate problems. Projects include educational content, research and testing.

Original jd.txt: Full-time with substantial Toronto overlap. Personal accomplishments in each tool, real failure/recovery and improvement examples, rate, working hours and earliest start are screening questions. These are not established by this sample.

intake-private.json personalization: Chang appears in two separate client reviews, Urgent: 3-Minute Software Product Video (ended 2026-09-17) and Bluebeam Tutor (ended 2025-12-17). Evidence supports client-contact first name only, not ownership.

The fractions brief, source excerpt, people, checkpoint times, test fixtures and outputs in this deck are invented illustrative data, not MapleSpark source materials or claims of work completed for MapleSpark.
Terminal transcripts use conceptual prompt/read/edit/command/review/result stages under extension-contract.md, not live sessions or importable workflow nodes.
